text:
Sam W: Quick postmortem follow-up from the vendor cascade last night (cloud IAM 429s -> model-registry leader churn -> client retry storms). I opened a mitigation playbook and dry-run checklist: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-9999. Please claim items, we want a dry-run next week.

Priyanka R: I'll own the local-cache + snapshot flow for model manifests. Plan: read-through bounded LRU, TTL=18s, snapshot fallback that is read-only and versioned. Will exclude presigned URLs and sign the manifest. ETA to demo: 2026-02-09.

Dmitri V: taking auth client hardening. Proposal: jittered exponential backoff, per-client token-bucket limiter, and a circuit breaker that trips after sustained 429s. I'll add a dashboard for auth_retry_ratio and tail-latency. ETA: 2026-02-06.

Claire J: security/runbook owner here 1: any local snapshot must be encrypted with KMS, have least-privilege ACLs, and a signed manifest for integrity checks. I'll update the runbook and pre-deploy checklist. ETA: 2026-01-31.

ops-bot: Follow-ups created: M-9999-1 (registry-cache), M-9999-2 (auth-hardening), M-9999-3 (runbook+kms). Owners must update status in tracker within 48h.

Sam W: Observations: spikes line up with provider-side 429 windows during midnight credential rotations and when registry leader election spikes latency. Short-term mitigations: small per-process cache, strict retry budgets, caller token buckets, and a dry-run of fallback routing to dedicated model-variants.

Priyanka R: cache details: LRU max_entries=6k, ttl=18s, snapshot gated behind a config flag for the dry-run. I'll add an integration test that simulates registry leader loss -> snapshot fallback. PR will be linked in tracker.

Dmitri V: auth snippet i'll propose in PR:
```
# auth client
retry_policy: exponential
initial_backoff_ms: 200
max_retries: 3
max_backoff_ms: 2500
jitter: true
circuit_breaker: failures=8, window=60s
token_bucket: rate=50/s, burst=100
```
This should limit retry amplification and provide clear alerting.

cloud-support-bot: Vendor ticket opened: CLOUD-IAM-24418. Vendor response: investigating high 429 bursts near credential-rotation windows. Asking for request patterns and client retry configs.

Claire J: I'll add a short checklist item: "encrypt snapshots + rotate KMS key post-deploy" and a note to run a dry-run on a staging cluster before enabling in prod.

Sam W: Ops governance for these actions:
- require secondary owner for actions >72h
- add estimated hours and weekly check-ins for ETA >7d
- tag cross-team PRs with "ops-review-required"
- include vendor contact and ticket ID in tracker entries
- schedule a 30m dry-run on staging with simulated registry 5xx and IAM 429s

Dmitri V: confirmed, i'll update M-9999-2 with PR and dashboard links. Will paste CLOUD-IAM-24418 vendor responses.

Priyanka R: claimed M-9999-1 and added PR + test plan. Marked in_progress.

Claire J: claimed M-9999-3 and updated runbook draft.

Sam W: Great. Please update tracker with concrete ETAs by EOD. I'll schedule the 30m dry-run for 2026-02-11 and invite owners. We'll reconvene after the dry-run to decide prod rollout. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: owners must update status within 48 hours or the action will be escalated.

Priyanka R: will update tracker now.

Dmitri V: updating M-9999-2 PR link shortly.

Claire J: will finish runbook edits tonight.

Sam W: Thanks everyone 1 I'll post a summary to leadership post-dry-run. :white_check_mark:
